translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.53:1: By the stars when they fade away
verses.53:2: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray
verses.53:3: Nor does he speak of his own whims
verses.53:4: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺
verses.53:5: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power
verses.53:6: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form
verses.53:7: while on the highest point above the horizon
verses.53:8: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close
verses.53:9: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less
verses.53:10: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺
verses.53:11: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw
verses.53:12: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw
verses.53:13: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
verses.53:14: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—
verses.53:15: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—
verses.53:16: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours
verses.53:17: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach
verses.53:18: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
verses.53:19: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza
verses.53:20: and the third one, Manât, as well
verses.53:21: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters
verses.53:22: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution
verses.53:23: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
verses.53:24: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire
verses.53:25: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next
verses.53:26: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves
verses.53:27: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
verses.53:28: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth
verses.53:29: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
verses.53:30: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.53:31: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
verses.53:32: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
verses.53:33: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
verses.53:34: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped
verses.53:35: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺
verses.53:36: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses
verses.53:37: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺
verses.53:38: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another
verses.53:39: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards
verses.53:40: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺
verses.53:41: then they will be fully rewarded
verses.53:42: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺
verses.53:43: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness
verses.53:44: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death
verses.53:45: And He created the pairs—males and females—
verses.53:46: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.53:47: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation
verses.53:48: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes
verses.53:49: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius
verses.53:50: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd
verses.53:52: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression
verses.53:53: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down
verses.53:55: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute
verses.53:56: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones
verses.53:58: None but Allah can disclose it
verses.53:59: Do you find this revelation astonishing
verses.53:60: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺
verses.53:62: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺
